profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded on NASDAQ under the ticker EH, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001759783. On its website the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle, or AAV, technology platform company and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It says it serves customers across industries with AAV products and commercial solutions in urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media.

The site lists passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions among its product and solution areas, and describes the company as a forerunner in the global urban air mobility industry. No litigation, no tracked product entries, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
